## How it was tested

- [ ] `server`: `npm test` (and `npm run build`)
- [ ] `web`: `npm test` and `npm run build`; E2E (`npx playwright test`) if the editor/UI changed
- [ ] `flutter/`: `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` if the apps/packages changed
- [ ] Screenshots / short video for visible changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin – see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] New or changed Yjs fields / object types: `docs/native_paritaet.md` and `shared/native.ts` updated
- [ ] New environment variables documented in `.env.example` and the README configuration table
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or real board content in code, fixtures or screenshots
